steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Access main control
steps.body: Remove console. Verify ALL connectors fully seated at ACU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove console. Verify ALL connectors fully seated at ACU.

steps.title: Restore power for line check
steps.body: Plug in or reconnect power for live measurements only.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Plug in or reconnect power for live measurements only.

steps.title: Line voltage J1-1 to J1-2
steps.body: AC voltmeter: black probe J1-1 (Neutral), red probe J1-2 (Line). Expect 120 VAC.

branches.label: No line voltage
branches.oemOutcome: Check outlet, breaker, and AC power cord continuity.

steps.sourceExcerpt: AC voltmeter: black probe J1-1 (Neutral), red probe J1-2 (Line). Expect 120 VAC.

steps.title: ACU status LED state
steps.body: After power-up: rapid flash then slow blink = micro OK. Steady ON = control malfunction. OFF = no 5 VDC. Rapid flash >30 sec or 2-quick-flash pattern = comm/load fault.

branches.label: Steady ON or rapid fault pattern

steps.sourceExcerpt: After power-up: rapid flash then slow blink = micro OK. Steady ON = control malfunction. OFF = no 5 VDC. Rapid flash >30 sec or 2-quick-flash pattern = comm/load fault.

steps.title: Isolate HMI load on J5
steps.body: Disconnect power. Remove connector J5 from main control. Restore power.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Remove connector J5 from main control. Restore power.

steps.title: +12 VDC at J5
steps.body: DC volts: black J5-4 (Circuit Gnd), red J5-1 (+12 VDC). Do not short pins inside header.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DC volts: black J5-4 (Circuit Gnd), red J5-1 (+12 VDC). Do not short pins inside header.

branches.label: No line voltage
branches.oemOutcome: Check outlet, breaker, and AC power cord continuity.

branches.label: Steady ON or rapid fault pattern

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 4.0–4.3 cu ft Top Load Washer (WTW4100 ACU)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Automatic Test valve pre-check
steps.body: In Automatic Test Mode, note any valve that fails during the water valve test sequence (cold then hot).
steps.sourceExcerpt: In Automatic Test Mode, note any valve that fails during the water valve test sequence (cold then hot).

steps.title: Disconnect J8 at ACU
steps.body: Unplug washer. Remove console. Disconnect J8 from main control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug washer. Remove console. Disconnect J8 from main control.

steps.title: Valve coil resistance at J8
steps.body: Measure each suspect coil across J8-1 (GND common) and valve pin: Cold J8-1&3, Hot J8-1&5, Fabric Softener J8-1&6 (dispenser models). Expect 1300–1540 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure each suspect coil across J8-1 (GND common) and valve pin: Cold J8-1&3, Hot J8-1&5, Fabric Softener J8-1&6 (dispenser models). Expect 1300–1540 Ω.

steps.title: Reconnect J8 and restore power
steps.body: Reconnect J8. Reassemble panels. Restore power for Automatic Test valve exercise.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect J8. Reassemble panels. Restore power for Automatic Test valve exercise.

steps.title: Continue to Automatic Test Mode
steps.body: You should now be in Service Diagnostic mode. Press Key 2, then press START (lid closed) to run Automatic Test load sequences.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Diagnostic mode must be active before Automatic Test Mode (Key 2 + START).

steps.title: Valves energize in Automatic Test
steps.body: Run Automatic Test Mode valve sequence. Does each valve in question turn on?

branches.label: Ohms OK but valve does not run
branches.oemOutcome: Coils in range but no run — replace main control and run Auto Test.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Run Automatic Test Mode valve sequence. Does each valve in question turn on?

branches.label: Ohms OK but valve does not run
branches.oemOutcome: Coils in range but no run — replace main control and run Auto Test.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 4.0–4.3 cu ft Top Load Washer (WTW4100 ACU)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Enter Service Diagnostic and clear codes
steps.body: Activate Service Diagnostic mode. Retrieve and clear F7E1, F7E3, F7E4, F7E6, F7E7 if present.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Activate Service Diagnostic mode. Retrieve and clear F7E1, F7E3, F7E4, F7E6, F7E7 if present.

steps.title: Wash/Agitate in Automatic Test
steps.body: Enter Automatic Test Mode (Key 2 + START). During wash step, does motor run after 15–20 seconds?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter Automatic Test Mode (Key 2 + START). During wash step, does motor run after 15–20 seconds?

steps.title: Spin Low Speed in Automatic Test
steps.body: During spin test, if motor hums briefly then shuts down, enter Fault Code Display and note codes.
steps.sourceExcerpt: During spin test, if motor hums briefly then shuts down, enter Fault Code Display and note codes.

steps.title: Continue to shifter or motor test
steps.body: Shifter/tach (F7E1, F7E3, F7E4) → TEST #3a Shifter. Motor circuit (F7E6, F7E7) → TEST #3b Motor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Shifter/tach (F7E1, F7E3, F7E4) → TEST #3a Shifter. Motor circuit (F7E6, F7E7) → TEST #3b Motor.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 4.0–4.3 cu ft Top Load Washer (WTW4100 ACU)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Spin and Wash in Automatic Test
steps.body: Lid closed and locked. Run Automatic Test wash and spin steps. Did shifter engage for both?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Lid closed and locked. Run Automatic Test wash and spin steps. Did shifter engage for both?

steps.title: Motor and shifter turn independently
steps.body: Power off. Motor and shifter should turn independently. If locked together, shifter slider issue.

branches.label: Locked together or basket bind
branches.oemOutcome: Resolve shifter slider bind or mechanical friction.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Motor and shifter should turn independently. If locked together, shifter slider issue.

steps.title: J2 and J6 fully seated
steps.body: Verify J2 and J6 inserted fully at main control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify J2 and J6 inserted fully at main control.

steps.title: Reseat J2/J6 and retest
steps.body: Reconnect connectors and repeat Automatic Test wash/spin.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect connectors and repeat Automatic Test wash/spin.

steps.title: Shifter motor resistance J6-2 to J6-6
steps.body: Remove J6. Expect 2 kΩ to 3.5 kΩ across shifter motor. Verify splutch cam moves freely.

testPoint.label: Shifter motor resistance J6-2 to J6-6

measurements.title: Shifter motor resistance J6-2 to J6-6

steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove J6. Expect 2 kΩ to 3.5 kΩ across shifter motor. Verify splutch cam moves freely.

steps.title: 120 VAC at shifter when commanded
steps.body: Restore power. AC volts J6-2 to J6-6. Toggle wash/spin in Automatic Test (motor must stop before shifter toggles). Expect 120 VAC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restore power. AC volts J6-2 to J6-6. Toggle wash/spin in Automatic Test (motor must stop before shifter toggles). Expect 120 VAC.

steps.title: Shifter switch voltage J2-1
steps.body: DC volts: black J2-2 (Gnd), red J2-1. Toggle wash/spin in Automatic Test — SPIN = +5 VDC, AGITATE = 0 VDC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DC volts: black J2-2 (Gnd), red J2-1. Toggle wash/spin in Automatic Test — SPIN = +5 VDC, AGITATE = 0 VDC.

steps.title: Tachometer +5 VDC and Hz verification
steps.body: DC volts J2-2 to J2-4 expect +5 VDC. In test cycle, AC/Hz on tach should increase as basket spins.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DC volts J2-2 to J2-4 expect +5 VDC. In test cycle, AC/Hz on tach should increase as basket spins.

steps.title: Shifter harness continuity
steps.body: Power off. Tilt washer. Continuity shifter pins to J2/J6 per OEM chart (pins 1–6)?

branches.label: Open harness
branches.oemOutcome: Replace lower washer harness.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Tilt washer. Continuity shifter pins to J2/J6 per OEM chart (pins 1–6)?

testPoint.label: Shifter motor resistance J6-2 to J6-6

measurements.title: Shifter motor resistance J6-2 to J6-6

branches.label: Locked together or basket bind
branches.oemOutcome: Resolve shifter slider bind or mechanical friction.

branches.label: Open harness
branches.oemOutcome: Replace lower washer harness.

steps.body: Verify J2 and J6 fully inserted at main control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify J2 and J6 fully inserted at main control.

steps.title: Reseat connectors and retest
steps.body: Reconnect J2/J6 and repeat Automatic Test wash/spin.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect J2/J6 and repeat Automatic Test wash/spin.

steps.title: Live motor voltage check
steps.body: Restore power. Run wash/agitate step in Automatic Test.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restore power. Run wash/agitate step in Automatic Test.

steps.title: 120 VAC cycling on CW winding
steps.body: AC volts J6-6 (Neutral) to J6-4 (CW). Expect 120 VAC cycling ON during CW rotation.

branches.label: No CW voltage
branches.oemOutcome: See TEST #1 Main Control (ACU).

steps.sourceExcerpt: AC volts J6-6 (Neutral) to J6-4 (CW). Expect 120 VAC cycling ON during CW rotation.

steps.title: 120 VAC cycling on CCW winding
steps.body: AC volts J6-6 (Neutral) to J6-1 (CCW). Expect 120 VAC cycling ON during CCW rotation.
steps.sourceExcerpt: AC volts J6-6 (Neutral) to J6-1 (CCW). Expect 120 VAC cycling ON during CCW rotation.

steps.title: Disconnect power for ohms
steps.body: Unplug washer. Remove J6 from main control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug washer. Remove J6 from main control.

steps.title: Motor winding resistance at J6
steps.body: CW J6-4↔6 and CCW J6-1↔6. Expect 3.5–6 Ω each.
steps.sourceExcerpt: CW J6-4↔6 and CCW J6-1↔6. Expect 3.5–6 Ω each.

steps.title: Motor harness continuity
steps.body: Tilt washer. Continuity motor connector to J6 and run capacitor per OEM chart?

branches.label: Open harness
branches.oemOutcome: Replace lower machine harness.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Tilt washer. Continuity motor connector to J6 and run capacitor per OEM chart?

steps.title: Motor resistance at drive connector
steps.body: At motor: CW pins 2↔3 and CCW pins 4↔2. Expect 3.5–6 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At motor: CW pins 2↔3 and CCW pins 4↔2. Expect 3.5–6 Ω.

steps.title: Run capacitor charge/discharge test
steps.body: Discharge capacitor with 20 kΩ resistor. Measure terminals — steady increase = good; short/open = replace capacitor.

branches.label: Capacitor shorted or open
branches.oemOutcome: Replace run capacitor, calibrate, and retest.

steps.title: Automatic Test fill step (70 mm)

steps.sourceExcerpt: During step 3, does drain pump run and washer sense 3 mm water remaining?

steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Remove console. Hose secure at transducer and tub dome? Routed without pinch? Clear of water/suds/debris?
